reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and adds a shared isNonWorkingDay, but the daily-skip predicate and skip-or-move dispatch are rewritten inline at each site.

duplication.why: `skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily'`, the off-day filter, the widened `take`, and the `skipWeekend && !skipsDailyWeekends ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date` ternary are repeated in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday matching and the move loop are in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily rule is decided in each server handler, and frequency is pushed into rschedule data in rule-utils to make it reachable.

scope.why: Edits stay on schedule date computation, tests and release notes; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: The weekend/daily/holiday rule is now spread over three call sites plus schedule-template's own skipWeekend ternary, each with its own look-ahead heuristic, so a future rule change must touch all of them.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) each decide skip vs move around getDateWithSkippedWeekend; schedule-template keeps its own skipWeekend ternary.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip logic appears as a `firstWeekday` closure in getNextDate, a filter/slice chain in getUpcomingDates and a loop `continue` in getDatesInRange: same decision, reshaped per site.

abstraction_drift.where: holidays added to getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the daily special case and the skipWeekend gate are re-decided outside it in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.
